programs.title: Deadliest Catch: Restricted Zone
programs.desc: Facing a global pandemic, the captains tie up half the fleet, leaving a handful of boats to catch the fleet-wide quota or face closure of the fishery.

programs.title: Alaska Gold Diggers: Ice Ice Baby
programs.desc: Approaching storm forces everyone to evacuate camp just as things are starting to look up: the women are forced to resort to desperate measures to yield a return on their investment when the mining ends early.

programs.title: Bering Sea Gold: Storm Ravaged
programs.desc: Stormy conditions force the miners to rethink their motivations  Shawn channels his inner MacGyver  Vern is confronted with a life-or-death decision.
